text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-W-What?! The diner's menu is doomed—?!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
'Yeah, it's pretty much at its limit. 
I was thinking it's time to retire it.'

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
!!!! 
N-No way... But you've worked so hard for 
so long...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Retiring is completely out of the 
question! 
Dad, pull yourself together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I won't let our diner close down— 
I'm going to save it!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
—I see. So you wish to save your family's 
diner 
through the power of medicinal cuisine.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes! After researching it thoroughly, 
I decided this is the only way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I found it on UmaTok. 
The answer to save me as I agonized over 
new dishes—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*Ta-daaaa!* 
'Top 10 Trending Food Spots You MUST 
Visit'!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All the dishes popular with young people 
in this video 
were super healthy and good for your body!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
The path of wellness is not built in a 
day. 
The spreading of wholesome ideals... is 
most commendable...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we've totally got to jump on the 
trend! 
Tasty munching, hooray for good health!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Then let your body experience 
the wonders of food as medicine—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Boosting metabolism for young and old 
alike— 
málàtāng. Now then... please, help 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoaaa... What a spicy smell... 
This is the dish everyone was gasping for 
breath over in the video.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
B-But—this is all to save the diner! 
*Nom!*

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's so numbbb-inggggg!! 
Heeeee! Sweat! S-Sweatttt!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Truly... a spice potent enough to 
stimulate one's qi. 
Perspiration promotes circulation—and 
soothes fatigue as well.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*Haa... haa...* Thank you for the meal. 
My body feels so toasty warmmm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Um, can the spiciness be toned down? 
I was thinking some people might not 
handle it well~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
At our diner, our philosophy is to make 
food 
that everyone can enjoy together—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
My dad and mom have always stood by that. 
Even with new menu items, I don't want to 
compromise on that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
My, my... what wonderful culinary souls. 
Then... allow me to impart ways for all to 
enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
To envelop the heat... egg-drop málàtāng. 
To add mellow richness... milk málàtāng. 
And, where acidity takes center stage 
rather than spice—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Tomato juice málàtāng. 
Please, have a taste...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! There are so many kinds... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: T-T-T-Tomato juiceee?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well... I can't handle tomato juice... 
Even though I'm fine with regular 
tomatoes... Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then we shall avoid this one. 
They say good medicine tastes bitter to 
the mouth, 
yet that is not our purpose today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'll eat it! 
I can't serve something to customers if I 
don't know the taste myself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I have to find out for sure 
if people can enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *Nom!* *Slurrrrp!*

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haboooooo~~~~~!!!!
choice_data_list: !!? What was that voice just now...?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: And so... how is it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Auugh... The tomato juice is definitely 
there... 
I really can't take it after allll~~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
B-But people who like it will love it! 
I'm adding it as a special variation...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... How valiant. And you, too, are 
truly 
a wonderful cook... well worthy of serving 
food.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... It's all for the shop! 
I'm gonna grab our customers right by 
their stomachs!
choice_data_list: What was that scream just now?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! Trainer! 
You really don't need to worry, you 
see...!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're all right...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! Trainer! 
You really don't need to worry, you 
see...!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're all right...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I ate something healthy, so 
I'm fit as a fiddle! 
*Hmph!*

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Urgh. 
I can still taste the tomato juice~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, you think so?! 
I see, I see~~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I definitely want to nail the aroma, not 
just the taste. 
All right, time to keep researching~~!
